title: Backend service implementation

any: backend source or service behavior changes
persistence, queue, or server-side state changes

requires.when: a public or shared contract changes

skill_calls.when: backend changes are authorized and ready
API or observable service behavior must be proven
command and functional evidence are ready to aggregate

nodes.obligation: Implement the bounded server-side behavior and preserve protected contracts.
Run the selected backend test strategy at current source and environment versions.

tests.evidence: request, response, error, authorization, and idempotency behavior

tests.when: database, queue, adapter, or service wiring changes
tests.evidence: real boundary integration at a controlled environment

workline_policy: Split when backend ownership, writes, environment, or evidence can be accepted independently from consumers.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE when no server, service, persistence, queue, adapter, or backend contract behavior changes.
repair: Test drift routes to test-autorepair only after behavior remains proven.
Contract drift reopens the shared-contract producer and affected consumers.
